results.title: Ireland – World wide web (www) site design services – Web development support services - 210901/7828
unknowns: Authoritative submission deadline still requires reconciliation
SPM alone has not evidenced the required qualifying web-project reference and complete key-profile set
results.why: Excellent web-development scope, but the DCE requires a qualifying completed web application/project of at least EUR 25,000 and specified personnel profiles, including a web project manager with at least three years of relevant experience and C1 English. Joint tendering, subcontracting and reliance on other entities are expressly available, making this a credible partner route rather than a lean-direct GREEN.

results.title: Belgium – Graphic design services – Provision of graphic design services and image-related services
unknowns: Exact minimum-turnover amount and lot-specific financial-capacity proof must be fully reconciled
SPM/partners must demonstrate the required professional capacity for the selected lot
results.why: Very strong creative/AI-assisted fit and the DCE does not prohibit AI use, but the European Parliament imposes a minimum financial/economic capacity per lot and professional-capacity evidence. Those gates are material and are not yet proven for SPM alone.

results.title: France – Graphic design services – Prestations de conseil en communication, conception graphique et editoriale, fabrication de supports et totems de communication, dans le cadre du projet ecocampus
unknowns: Exact lot-specific technical/reference minimums and fabrication logistics remain to be proven
SPM needs a credible physical fabrication/installation route for supports and totems
results.why: Open French framework combining communication advice, graphic/editorial design and fabrication. The framework has no minimum order amount and can run for one year with up to three renewals. Creative work is a strong fit, but physical-support/totem delivery and reference/capacity evidence prevent a clean GREEN today.

results.title: Ireland – Internet services – Trócaire RFT Website Development and Maintenance Services
unknowns: TED and national eTenders deadline metadata require reconciliation
SPM alone has not evidenced the required recent website references, large e-commerce/Salesforce experience and insurance
results.why: Native WordPress/web-maintenance scope, but the RFT asks for at least three websites designed and delivered in the last 24 months with actual references, plus large e-commerce/payment-provider and heavily customised Salesforce integration experience, multiple environments, security and adequate insurance. Partnerable, not lean-direct.

results.title: France – Printing services – Prestations d’impression pour l’Institut de France
unknowns: Exact technical/reference and sample requirements per lot need final verification
Compliant print supplier, BPU economics and delivery logistics are not yet locked
results.why: Open two-lot printing framework with unit-price ordering and long bid runway. The DCE asks for turnover information for up to the last three available financial years and technical-capacity declarations, but the compact evidence does not establish a disqualifying numeric turnover threshold. Strong print-broker candidate, but supplier economics and exact lot gates remain unresolved.

results.title: France – Motion picture and video services – Prestations de captation vidéo, de production audiovisuelle (avec ou sans scénarisation), de post-production et de réalisation de supports vidéo accessibles pour le compte de l’université de Montpellier Paul-Valéry
unknowns: Exact minimum level, if any, attached to professional references/capacity must be confirmed
SPM needs a credible local/on-site capture crew and civil-liability insurance evidence
results.why: Strong new SPM-fit audiovisual opportunity. Two lots cover video capture/production and accessible video; the scope expressly includes post-production, transfer of rushes and all versions, and motion-design/interactive integration. Participation is not reserved, capacity from other economic operators may be relied upon with written commitment, electronic tender submission is supported and payment is on a 30-day university cycle. Physical capture in Herault and remaining bidder-capacity proof keep it just below GREEN.
